## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# You Don’t Have to Navigate This Alone

Whether you’re just starting to explore LDN or have been on your journey for years, there’s a place
for you here.

Join a steady, supportive community where experiences are shared thoughtfully and respectfully.

[Join the LDN Community][149]

The LDN Research Trust Charity works to raise funds for research trials.  We have helped over
100,000 people obtain LDN from a General Practitioner or Consultant, either through the National
Health Service or by private prescription. We are proud to have helped people not just in the UK,
but in countries throughout Europe; as well as the USA, Canada, West Indies, Australia, New Zealand,
and beyond.

## LDN Conference Recordings

Missed the LDN 2026 Virtual Conference? Watch the full recordings online and catch up on the latest
LDN research, insights and expert presentations. 30% Discount for members.

[Get access today][1

# You Don’t Have to Navigate This Alone

Whether you’re just starting to explore LDN or have been on your journey for years, there’s a place
for you here.

Join a steady, supportive community where experiences are shared thoughtfully and respectfully.

[Join the LDN Community][149]

The LDN Research Trust Charity works to raise funds for research trials.  We have helped over
100,000 people obtain LDN from a General Practitioner or Consultant, either through the National
Health Service or by private prescription. We are proud to have helped people not just in the UK,
but in countries throughout Europe; as well as the USA, Canada, West Indies, Australia, New Zealand,
and beyond.

## LDN Conference Recordings

Missed the LDN 2026 Virtual Conference? Watch the full recordings online and catch up on the latest
LDN research, insights and expert presentations. 30% Discount for members.

[Get access today][150]

[30% Discount for Members][151]

## Conditions LDN can help with

LDN can work very well for Multiple Sclerosis (MS), Crohn’s Disease, Fibromyalgia, ME/CFS, Chronic
Pain, Mental Health Issues, Women’s Health, Autism etc. Check out our Condition List.

[Check out our Condition List][152]

 

## Support LDN Research Trust

As an organisation we are 100% reliant on your support to keep reliable, science based content about
LDN available online. Our LDN-related content is being restricted or wrongly blocked by platforms
such as Google and Meta. To combat this we are 100% reliant on your support so please, if LDN
Research Trust has helped you, please consider membership or making a donation to keep us online.

but in countries throughout Europe; as well as the USA, Canada, West Indies, Australia, New Zealand,
and beyond.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

CLOMID® (clomiphene citrate) is a prescription medicine used for the treatment of ovulatory
dysfunction in female adults trying to become pregnant.

**Before starting CLOMID**®, tell your doctor about all of your medical conditions, including if
you:

- have a known hypersensitivity or allergy to clomiphene citrate or any of its ingredients

- have a history of liver problems 

- have abnormal menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding of undetermined origin.

- have ovarian cysts or enlargement not due to polycystic ovarian syndrome 

- have a history of polycystic ovarian syndrome 

- have uncontrolled thyroid or kidney problems or adrenal dysfunction

- have preexisting or family history of high cholesterol 

- are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if CLOMID® passes into your breast milk.
CLOMID® may reduce lactation.

- are pregnant.

- have any organic intracranial lesion such as pituitary tumor.

**Tell your doctor** about all of the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. Tell your doctor if you start a new
medicine. CLOMID® may affect the way other medicines work, and other medicines may affect how
CLOMID® works.

Clomid^{®} (clomiPHENE citrate) Tablets, USP is a proven, prescription fertility medication that has
helped millions of women. It works by stimulating an increase in hormones that support ovulation.

## Why Clomid^{®}

You’re taking the next important step on your journey to having a baby. And we’re here to help. As
one of the most prescribed female infertility treatments, Clomid^{®} is a champion of women around
the world who take action to create the life they dream of for themselves, their partners, and their
families.

[Clomid medication packaging.]
[Couple hugging and celebrating a positive pregnancy test.]

> When I saw the plus sign on the test stick I was so relieved and happy.

Amy K.

### The birth of a movement.

Cosette is committed to helping women access, and afford life-changing medications like Clomid®
(clomiphene citrate).

[See How][20]

### Talk to your doctor about Clomid^{®}

#### Infertility & Treatments

**IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION & INDICATIONS**

[ View More View Less ][34]

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

CLOMID® (clomiphene citrate) is a prescription medicine used for the treatment of ovulatory
dysfunction in female adults trying to become pregnant.

**Before starting CLOMID**®, tell your doctor about all of your medical conditions, including if
you:

- have a known hypersensitivity or allergy to clomiphene citrate or any of its ingredients

- have a history of liver problems 

- have abnormal menstrual bleeding or abnormal uterine bleeding of undetermined origin.

- have ovarian cysts or enlargement not due to polycystic ovarian syndrome 

- have a history of polycystic ovarian syndrome 

- have uncontrolled thyroid or kidney problems or adrenal dysfunction

- have preexisting or family history of high cholesterol 

- are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if CLOMID® passes into your breast milk.
CLOMID® may reduce lactation.

- are pregnant.

- have any organic intracranial lesion such as pituitary tumor.

**Tell your doctor** about all of the medicines you take, including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. Tell your doctor if you start a new
medicine. CLOMID® may affect the way other medicines work, and other medicines may affect how
CLOMID® works.

**The most common side effects** of CLOMID® are enlarged ovaries, hot flashes and abdominal or
pelvic pain/distension, discomfort and bloating, headache, nausea, and vomiting. Blurred vision and
other visual symptoms may also occur during or after taking CLOMID®, which may be prolonged or
potentially irreversible. Multiple pregnancies may occur. Prolonged use of CLOMID® may increase the
risk of a borderline or invasive ovarian tumor. Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome may occur and can
progress rapidly and become a serious medical disorder. These are not all of the possible side
effects of CLOMID®. For more information, ask your doctor.

**You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs to the FDA.
Visit **[**www.fda.gov/medwatch**][35]** or call **[**1-800-FDA-1088**][36]**.**

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Areas of Focus

#### Revolutionary medicines enable us to enrich and extend life for people living with all types of
#### diseases. 

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115] 
[Milestones][116] 
[Pipeline & Clinical Trials ][117]

Cancer treatment needs to be transformed across the entire landscape to significantly improve the
lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

#### Starting with Charles Pfizer inventing an almond-flavored antiparasite medicine in 1849, our
#### people have always been innovators and trailblazers, committed to finding the next cure. 

[ Learn More About Us Details][124]

#### An Accord for a Healthier World

Where people live shouldn’t impact the quality of their healthcare and income shouldn’t determine
health outcomes.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce

## best Services & Products

Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while

## Sunderland makes sense

We’re a small city with a big impact. Choose Sunderland and you’ll be choosing a community that
knows your name, challenges you to grow, and supports you every step of the way.

Our city is changing fast. Over £400 million of investment is transforming Sunderland into one of
the north-east’s most exciting places to live, study, and build a future. A city by the sea and on
the rise.

* A printed guide designed to clear the noise, delivered to your door (UK residents only).

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.
[Read →][10]
[[The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration]][11]
[Pharma Frontiers][12]
10 min read
[
The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration
][13]
22 January 2026
Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.
[Read →][14]
Check out our latest report
[View all reports →][15]
[[2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report]][16]

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

##### SynZeal is looking forward to participating in Pharmaconex 2026, a premier pharmaceutical

## Past Events

SynZeal successfully participated in CPHI China 2026, one of Asia’s leading pharmaceutical industry
events, bringing together pharmaceutical manufacturers, suppliers, innovators, and industry
professionals from around the world. As a premier platform for pharmaceutical innovation,
networking, and business development, the event provided an excellent opportunity to connect with
people, explore emerging industry trends, and showcase SynZeal’s commitment to quality, excellence,
and customer-centric solutions. We were delighted to engage with industry leaders, strengthen
existing relationships, and build new collaborations that will drive future growth and innovation.

##### Fluocinonide Related Products

Fluocinonide is a synthetic glucocorticoid and derivative of fluocinolone acetonide with
anti-inflammatory and antipruritic activities. Fluocinonide is a potent glucocorticoid used
topically as an anti-inflammatory agent for the treatment of skin disorders such as eczema and
seborrhoeic dermatitis.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Your questions, answered

### Where does Universal Drugstore ship to, and how long does delivery take?

We ship to all destinations within the United States (including Alaska and Hawaii), as well as
internationally. Orders over $100 shipping within the U.S. qualify for free shipping; orders under
$100 have a flat $7 USD shipping fee. International orders outside the U.S. have a flat-rate
shipping fee of $19.95 USD.

Estimated delivery times are approximately 2 weeks for U.S. and Canada, and approximately 4 weeks
for international orders. Delivery times may vary based on location, customs clearance, and other
factors beyond our control.

### Is a prescription required to order medications on Universal Drugstore?

At Universal Drugstore, you’ll need to provide a valid prescription from a licensed medical
professional to purchase prescription medications. Our pharmacy team carefully verifies all
prescriptions before processing any orders. If you have questions about your prescription, feel free
to reach out to our customer support team, and we’ll guide you through the process.

### How do I submit my prescription on Universal Drugstore?

To submit your prescription at Universal Drugstore, simply upload it securely during checkout or
email it to our dedicated prescription service. Our licensed pharmacists will review and validate
the prescription before fulfilling your order.

### What payment methods are accepted by Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore accepts a variety of secure payment options to make ordering prescriptions safe
and convenient. We currently accept Visa, Mastercard, international money orders, and eChecks
(electronic checks).

An eCheck, or electronic check, allows you to pay directly from your bank account through a secure
digital process. This method is facilitated via the Automated Clearing House (ACH) network, offering
a reliable alternative to traditional paper checks.

All transactions are processed securely, and our team is here to support you in choosing the best
payment method for your needs.

### How do I place a refill order on Universal Drugstore?

You can log in to your account on the pharmacy's website to place a refill order or call Universal
Drugstore directly and speak to our team to place an order via the phone.

### What is the maximum quantity of medication I can purchase on Universal Drugstore?

Customers can typically purchase & import up to a 3-month supply of each medication, provided they
have a valid prescription for that quantity.

### Are generic medications available on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore offers over 4,000 medications, many being generic equivalents of brand-name
medications.

### Do you offer discounts or promotions on Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore offers many savings programs for our customers. This includes seasonal
promotions, a loyalty program to earn points and save on your next purchase, a referral program and
more.

### Do you offer automatic refills on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore has a seemless refill program through our website, email or phone, to
ensure all customers can get their refilled medication on time.

### Can I use my insurance to pay for medications on Universal Drugstore?

### What is the maximum quantity of medication I can purchase on Universal Drugstore?

Customers can typically purchase & import up to a 3-month supply of each medication, provided they
have a valid prescription for that quantity.

### Are generic medications available on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore offers over 4,000 medications, many being generic equivalents of brand-name
medications.

### Do you offer discounts or promotions on Universal Drugstore?

Universal Drugstore offers many savings programs for our customers. This includes seasonal
promotions, a loyalty program to earn points and save on your next purchase, a referral program and
more.

### Do you offer automatic refills on Universal Drugstore?

Yes, Universal Drugstore has a seemless refill program through our website, email or phone, to
ensure all customers can get their refilled medication on time.

### Can I use my insurance to pay for medications on Universal Drugstore?

with very low publication fees. WJARR maintains a high impact factor (Impact factor 8.2) and is
committed to providing authors with a timely and efficient review process for evaluation of their
manuscripts.

communications, and case reports** across a wide range of scientific disciplines including
Biological Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Sciences, Nursing, Health Sciences,
Agriculture, Life Sciences, Engineering and Technology and other related fields.

The aim of WJARR is to establish a global platform for exchanging ideas and new emerging trends
within the scientific community. The journal is committed to publishing articles that strengthen the
knowledge of academicians, researchers and scientists. Each manuscript is selected for its original
contribution to scholarly research and is reviewed to ensure intellectual rigor and relevance to
academic and professional communities.

## WJARR is an International ISSN Approved Journal

**World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews (WJARR)** is an international journal dedicated to
the publication of high-quality research and review articles. WJARR is an ISSN approved journal with
e-ISSN **2581-9615**. The journal is an **open access** publication issued with a monthly frequency
(12 issues per year).

World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews is a **peer-reviewed and highly indexed journal**
ensuring quality scholarly publication. The journal offers authors an affordable publication process
with very low publication fees. WJARR maintains a high impact factor (Impact factor 8.2) and is
committed to providing authors with a timely and efficient review process for evaluation of their
manuscripts.

The journal publishes **original research articles, review articles, mini-reviews, short
communications, and case reports** across a wide range of scientific disciplines including
Biological Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Sciences, Nursing, Health Sciences,
Agriculture, Life Sciences, Engineering and Technology and other related fields.

The aim of WJARR is to establish a global platform for exchanging ideas and new emerging trends
within the scientific community. The journal is committed to publishing articles that strengthen the
knowledge of academicians, researchers and scientists. Each manuscript is selected for its original
contribution to scholarly research and is reviewed to ensure intellectual rigor and relevance to
academic and professional communities.
